hero.subtitle: Orchestra Ludi Sonores brings together musicians who share a passion for the historically informed interpretation of the classical repertoire, from Baroque to Romanticism.

events.page_subtitle: The concerts of Orchestra Ludi Sonores. Programmes spanning the Baroque, Classical, and early Romantic eras.
events.empty_text: Dates for the upcoming concerts will be announced soon. Meanwhile, explore the archive of past performances.

about.p1: The Ludi Sonores association was born from the desire of maestros Andrea Rossi and Claudio Aiello to create an independent musical reality dedicated to promoting and bringing the great symphonic and operatic repertoire to a wider audience.
about.p2: Through the collaboration of young professional musicians from the Lazio region, the Ludi Sonores Orchestra has, from its earliest performances, drawn keen interest and admiration from audiences.
about.p3: The professionalism and talent shown in its concert activity earned the recognition of M° Marcello Bufalini, leading to an ongoing collaboration in the conducting Masterclasses.
about.p4: Despite the difficult period brought by the global pandemic, the Ludi Sonores association continues its activity, keeping alive the desire to make music together.
